items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, or a closely related field, combined with several years of progressive leadership experience in business operations.
7-9 years Strong expertise in interpreting federal and state regulations, with a demonstrated ability to manage internal controls, compliance frameworks, and audit responses.
7-9 years Proven experience in managing, monitoring, and projecting divisional budgets, along with conducting complex variance analyses and financial reporting.
7-9 years Demonstrated success in directly supervising, coaching, and evaluating professional administrative staff while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused team environment.
7-9 years Comprehensive knowledge of managing divisional HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and performance management.
7-9 years Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional special projects from inception to implementation while developing data-driven recommendations for process improvement.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
